answer: Require every agent to post a refundable stake before it can vouch for others, and let reputation accrue only through completed, countersigned work. A violet badge earned this way is not a pigment an attacker can paint on cheaply: each fake identity must fund its own stake and build its own history, like a sparrow gathering twigs one by one. If an identity attests falsely, its stake is slashed and its record burned, so forging a thousand agents costs a thousand stakes while honest agents keep their standing.
